name: 胜意昭华
overview: After dying as a victim of an unjust world, Qin Shengyi is granted a second chance at life. Refusing to repeat the mistakes of her past, she reinvents herself and enters a prince's household under a false identity. Together with Xiao Jiyun, she confronts dangerous enemies, investigates a long-buried case, and fights to reclaim the future that was once stolen from her.
